summary: Interpreted the BatchApplyCh receipt and requested the correction it needs. VerifyLeader's strand reproduced (indices 1, 7, 13) and so did the unbuffered contrast: Barrier and Apply answered all eight post-shutdown calls in every trial (indices 3, 9, 15 and 5, 11, 17). The new batched cases show the flip — with applyCh buffered, Barrier answered 4, 5 and 6 of eight post-shutdown calls and Apply 4, 4 and 3, leaving the rest unanswered after 500ms — which pins the mechanism to channel buffering, since Config.BatchApplyCh exists precisely to buffer applyCh and its own comment warns it breaks the timeout guarantee on Apply. The declared comparisons for those cases came back unresolved rather than satisfied because the batched cases reuse trial and kind with the unbuffered ones, making the admitting setup event ambiguous; I recorded the event-level values, noted that limitation explicitly, and submitted a revision that gives the batched cases trial identifiers 100-102 and carries batch_apply_ch on the setup event too. Joint history across the three harness revisions is recorded, and no earlier receipt is withdrawn.
